status: G3 pilot: processed, compressed and reviewed from Tripo's render and four views; its camps (II, VI, VIII) not yet captured in the game
use: A tent struck for the march, in the camps of the retreats.

generator.prompt: A Roman eight-man leather tent struck for the march: its stitched goatskin panels folded and rolled into one long bundle tied with rope, the ridge pole and two upright poles laid beside it, a coil of guy rope and a leather bag of wooden pegs. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and strong readable silhouette, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.
